Intake note (Commercial team, 27 December 2019). Our client Neha Bhatt is a 62-year-old architect who lives at Plot 7, Alkapuri, Vadodara 390043 and can be reached on +91 86989 82080 or neha.bhatt@example.in. The client's PAN UANPB6266Q.
The client consulted us about a aircraft lease repossession matter (Project Kestrel) against M/s Vindhya Aviation Ltd. The aircraft lease repossession against M/s Vindhya Aviation Ltd concerns arrears of INR 1,35,46,00,000/-; the airline sought protection from its creditors.
The matter was filed as CS(COMM) 2224/2020 before the Gujarat High Court on 30 April 2020.
